BiblicalUsage: Chittiyth is terror, the dread that a great power spreads, and Ezekiel uses it only of Tyre and Egypt. Tyre was a terror in the sea, and the slain of Egypt go down to the pit with the terror they spread in the land of the living.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the terror of the great powers is real but short-lived, because God brings every terror to the pit. I hold that no empire's fear outlasts God's judgment on it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
